notes.title: Patch Notes 9/6/2021
notes.content:
Hey guys,
Thanks to everyone who supported the launch of "Clarence Goes to the F*#%ING Store!" I have a few minor issues to address with today's patch:
[list]
[*]Fixed various typos
[*]Replaced some music throughout the game
[*]Expanded the About section
[/list]

I hope you've all had a great time with the game, and thank you again for taking the time to check out my game!

FourteenSpoons
Bad Gremlin Studios
